# 安装MindIE

#### 安装前必读

执行安装前请确保安装环境满足[硬件环境](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/10RC3/envdeployment/instg/mindie_instg_0004.html)，[支持的操作系统](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/10RC3/envdeployment/instg/mindie_instg_0005.html)要求，并已参照[安装驱动和固件](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/10RC3/envdeployment/instg/mindie_instg_0006.html)和[安装开发环境](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/10RC3/envdeployment/instg/mindie_instg_0008.html)章节完成开发环境的安装。执行MindIE软件包的安装，会依次安装MindIE RT、MindIE Torch、MindIE Service、MindIE LLM和MindIE SD各组件，组件包的路径在MindIE的子路径下。
